messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 — Write errors observed in canary deploy of release/2026.03.15. Auto-paging oncall.

deploy-bot: started canary rollout to 2% of traffic at 15:02 UTC, migration v32 applied to canary replicas only.

hana (sre): I'm oncall. seeing elevated 5xx on /v1/items POST in Grafana alert (error rate ~12% for canary).

matt (backend): rolling service 2026.03.15+1 includes code that writes to new column `metadata_v2` expecting NOT NULL. DB migration was supposed to backfill but migration only ran on primary, not all canary reader replicas.

li (db): checked migration logs — v32 ALTER TABLE ran as transactional DDL on primary. But async replica catch-up lag present for canary DB pool `canary-pool-3`. some replicas are still behind WAL by ~30s. that could cause write conflict with some prepared statements.

olivia (frontend): customers hitting 500s when saving draft. support count rising (see thread).

sam (support-l2): we have 23 affected customer sessions, two enterprise customers reporting failed saves. no data loss confirmed yet, most failures are rejected writes (500).

hana (sre): initial mitigation: pause canary rollout and flip feature flag that sent traffic to new write path. can someone run the kill switch?

matt (backend): doing it now. command: `ffctl set production.canary_write_path false --by=release/2026.03.15`

deploy-bot: feature flag updated: production.canary_write_path=false by matt. Canary traffic diverted to stable write path.

hana (sre): nice. Observability: error rate dropped to baseline within ~45s. No new customer writes failing in the last 2 minutes.

li (db): still seeing some write retries failing due to NOT NULL constraint on `metadata_v2` when writes hit a replica that hasn't applied backfill yet. We should avoid any migration DDL that changes constraints before replicas are fully caught up.

matt (backend): agreed. plan: rollback service to previous image on canary hosts and promote full rollback if stable. Also coordinate DB fix: backfill metadata_v2 on all shards and then ALTER to NOT NULL only after consistency.

product-ops: customer impact: short window of failed saves mainly in canary — flagged two enterprise customers for notification. no billing impact. we need a post-incident note for comms.

hana (sre): matt — can you rollback canary image now? call out when complete.

matt (backend): initiating rollback for canary group. command: `kubectl set image deploy/backend=registry/redwood/backend:2026.03.14 --namespace=canary`

deploy-bot: rollback started. will update when pods are ready.

matt (backend): canary pods at 3/3 ready for previous image. monitoring errorrate.

hana (sre): error rate for /v1/items POST back to normal. support confirmations coming in.

sam (support-l2): customers reporting saves ok now. closing immediate tickets. will keep monitoring for 1 hour and escalate if anything reappears.

li (db): next steps for DB: 1) run backfill script on canary and primary shards with throttling: `python tools/backfill_metadata_v2.py --shards all --batch 10k` 2) after verifying rows updated, run ALTER TABLE .. SET NOT NULL during low traffic window with migration lock.

matt (backend): we'll block the release until DB backfill + replica sync complete. create a rollback ticket in JIRA and mark release paused.

product-ops: creating customer comms draft: shortlist impacted customers, timeline, and apology. will share for review.

hana (sre): oncall handoff: I'm staying on until 16:00 UTC or until we handoff to next oncall. paging next oncall now. @olivia can you take the followup handoff if it falls into your shift?

olivia (frontend): can take it after 15:50 UTC.

incident-bot: Note — escalation policy: if incident still open after 1h, escalate to eng-leads and runtime.

li (db): quick note: add replica lag check to migration playbook; require zero lag for all read replicas before applying NOT NULL. filing PR for playbook updates.

matt (backend): filing rollback + blocked-release tickets: RD-5123 (release pause), RD-5124 (rollback verification).

sam (support-l2): closing immediate customer tickets, adding internal note referencing this thread.

hana (sre): summary for postmortem: root cause = migration + deploy ordering mismatch + replica lag causing partial application of NOT NULL constraint semantics to canary traffic. mitigations = feature-flag kill, canary rollback, DB backfill plan, playbook update. owners: matt (service rollback), li (DB backfill), hana (incident exec), product-ops (customer comms).

product-ops: will schedule postmortem doc and a 30-min exec sync tomorrow.

incident-bot: Incident P1 resolved (impact contained) — set status: mitigated. All followups tracked in RD tickets.

hana (sre): will update oncall log and mark incident as mitigated. leaving detailed notes in the ticket. thanks everyone. :pray:
